goal: A thesis author can validate local BibTeX keys and build deterministic inline citations plus a referenced-only GB/T 7714-2025 bibliography offline.
non_goals: Do not use network metadata lookup or remote CSL downloads.
Do not require citeproc-py for core validate or build.
Do not add Template Model citation layout fields.
Do not implement atomic output or failed-rebuild preservation before task 007.
Do not claim complete GB/T 7714-2025 coverage beyond documented V1 types.
Do not add UI, account, marketplace or AI behavior.
expected_evidence: Observed RED and GREEN BibTeX loader and formatter golden tests
Malformed, duplicate-key and unsupported-type BibTeX errors
Missing citation key ValidationIssue with source line
Deterministic grouped inline citation text and first-use order
Body and footnote citation DOCX text assertions
Full pytest, Ruff and pip check output
Offline validate/build, package inspection, reload and LibreOffice conversion
Task report, independent spec review and independent quality review
unsafe_assumptions: BibTeX file existence does not prove valid or supported records.
BibTeX file order is not citation order.
Uncited records must not appear under referenced-only policy.
Raw Markdown citation text is not formatted citation evidence.
Bibliography formatting must remain independent of DOCX and network services.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation crosses DOCX-independent bibliography boundaries, edits outside the allowlist, bypasses unresolved-citation validation, claims unsupported GB/T coverage, or requires task-007 atomic output behavior.
